title: Kind Of Blue
label: Columbia
notes:
Columbia 6-Eye, nonbreakable labels with “Stereo Fidelity” at the top, and bold typeface for album title (both sides).

Terre Haute pressing variant. Side 2 on the jacket back incorrectly lists “Flamenco Sketches” as the first track and “All Blues” as the second track. Side 2 labels list the songs correctly and audio plays in the correct order, indicating a November 1959 pressing.

“T” etched in runouts denotes Columbia Records Pressing Plant, Terre Haute, pressing.
“6” printing on jacket back bottom rights denotes fabrication by Imperial Packing Co., Inc., Indianapolis IN.

Julian “Cannonball” Adderley’s last name is misspelled as “Adderly” on the front and back cover. Wynton Kelly appears as “Wyn Kelly” on the back cover.

identifiers.description: Fabricator code, jacket back bottom right

formats: Vinyl LP Album Misprint Repress Stereo
labelNotes: Terre Haute plant named via 'T' etch. Format descriptor 'Repress' denies first pressing (borderline: descriptor, not prose).
